description: This Java class 'AutowiredCredentialsManagementAdapter' is a Spring component that acts as an adapter for the CredentialsManagementService, wiring it to an event bus implementation. It is part of the device registry service in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: AutowiredCredentialsManagementAdapter
classes.description: A Spring component that extends EventBusCredentialsManagementAdapter, injecting a CredentialsManagementService instance for use within the application.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Sets the CredentialsManagementService implementation to be used by this adapter, injected via Spring's @Autowired and @Qualifier.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the internally injected CredentialsManagementService instance.
